packages.name: @velaros-ai/agent
packages.description: Act execution loop, durable run control and bounded child scheduling for VelarOS Platform.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/core
packages.description: VelarOS 跨领域共享的底层：断言、错误、结果、类型守卫与无领域语义的通用原语，外加三个底层单元——platform（跨平台约定：路径文本、shell 命令规格、进程与系统信息命令、应用与数据目录、VelarOS 共享资源目录）、text-files（磁盘文本的无损读写：认编码、严格解码、按原编码写回、原子替换、有界读）与 path-rules（glob 匹配、.gitignore 的解析与判定、遍历时的忽略策略）。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/agent-lab
packages.description: 可复现的连续旅程评测：诊断、统计与认证，连同 velaros-agent-lab 命令行；不认宿主。

packages.name: @velaros-ai/context
packages.description: Shared task state, immutable evidence and runtime materialization for ScriptAct.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/script
packages.description: Code surface for capability spaces: the model writes a JavaScript ES module that imports generated capability declarations, the program is typechecked before it runs, and it executes in an isolated process whose only reachable capabilities are the host operations it calls back into.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/velaros
packages.description: The capability units the model imports as velaros:* modules and every space mounts with its own port (products assemble the spaces; each unit's ./local entry gives its port on this machine): files (machine files, system space; with the machine file port and a global search for host UIs underneath), images (view pictures within provider limits; with the machine image port, sips on macOS), shell (run commands; with the local machine host underneath: background tasks, interactive consoles, shell selection, process confinement, the Windows process host, and the processes, ports and metrics a host UI shows), sandbox (rehearse in a mirror, then apply; with the local rehearsal sandbox underneath), project (governed project files and code questions: velaros:project and velaros:code, with the project kernel and its transactions underneath, and the ports a project hands to shell, sandbox and images), computer (desktop control: screenshots, pointer, keyboard, with the helper sidecar runtime underneath), memory (long-term memory: one directory of Markdown files per host-given scope, plus the index a host puts at the start of each session), office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel generation, PDF reading and editing, Word and LaTeX to PDF, document preview and Markdown conversion, with the document engines underneath and the narrow renderer primitives the Document Renderer uses) and browser (velaros:browser to drive and read pages, velaros:devtools for console, network, storage, performance, recording, emulation and user scripts, with the CDP drivers, page engines, Electron session runtime and site workspace underneath). One plain directory per unit, one convention for all.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/kernel
packages.description: VelarOS library-first microkernel: contracts, in-process runtime, thin client, and optional serve deployment.

packages.name: @velaros-ai/model
packages.description: Model provider adapters, provider script integration, and runtime model resolution for VelarOS-compatible hosts.
